title: Two-NPC Dialogue Template
premise: Test two NPCs at the same location asking each other questions and sharing facts; optionally test giving items. For simulation, select Anna+Ben (or all NPCs).

locations.name: Plaza
locations.description: The town square. The two often meet here.

locations.name: Garden
locations.description: A quiet back garden. Their agreed meeting spot.

persons.name: Observer
persons.background: A quiet bystander who prefers watching others rather than intervening.

persons.name: Anna
persons.background: Earnest and polite. Looking for Ben; she does not know where they should meet later.
persons.goal: Find Ben and learn where to meet

persons.name: Ben
persons.background: Calm village courier. Knows the Garden meeting place and carries a Token for Anna; prefers being clear and helpful.
persons.goal: Help Anna when she asks, then go to the Garden

items.name: Token
items.description: A small brass token Ben should give to Anna.

quests.name: FindMeetingPlace
quests.description: Anna learns from Ben that they meet in the Garden, then goes there.
quests.objective: Anna and Ben both reach Garden after exchanging the meeting place (and Token).

facts.name: MeetInGarden
facts.text: Anna and Ben should meet later in the Garden next to the Plaza.

facts.name: BenKnowsPlan
facts.text: Ben already knows the meeting place is the Garden. After talking with Anna he should go there too.

facts.name: BenHasToken
facts.text: Ben is carrying a Token meant for Anna; he can give it to her at the Plaza.

facts.name: AnnaSeeksBen
facts.text: Anna is at the Plaza and needs to ask Ben where they should meet.
